capabilities: Search DuckDuckGo, Bright Data, Brave and Wikimedia Commons for medical images
Filter results with medical mode pills such as anatomy, radiology, histology and clinical
Scan a full note, selection, heading section or line range with an offline rules engine or Gemini
Review, retry and resize results in a batch modal
Insert images at a bullet or paragraph with list indentation and save them to an attachments folder
extras: Defaults to DuckDuckGo with no key; Bright Data is described as 5,000 free requests per month. Installable on mobile via LiveSync/Folder Sync or BRAT.
motivation: The author built a mobile version with no Node.js or Electron imports so the plugin loads natively in Obsidian on iPadOS and Android, with a touch-first interface.
problem: On iPad and Android, finding suitable medical images and placing them at an exact bullet or paragraph is slow, since desktop-oriented plugins and hover-based interfaces do not work well there.

relations.evidence: search DuckDuckGo Images (free default, zero API keys)
optional Bright Data Google Images (serp_api1) and Brave Image Search API
optional Bright Data Google Images (serp_api1) and Brave Image Search API
Enter a free Google AI Studio key in Settings for 1-tap automated scanning

summary: Mobile-first plugin that searches image engines for medical images, scans notes for image needs, and inserts chosen images at a specific note point.
